_why_two_files: ONE HARNESS, TWO FRAMES, and the second is the one the bots run. The 5-minute file covers 2026-07-03 -> 2026-09-09 (two months); the 15-minute file covers 2025-11-03 -> 2026-09-09 (ten months) on the frame SOS Fade and B-LEG replay the fib on. Same code either way, five times the calendar. Both came off the harness as it has stood since 2026-09-03, a minute apart. Each warm-up is measured on its OWN file - one number for both would be a guess for one of them.
_why_skip_macro: The MACRO (cycle) fib is a deliberate fork and cannot pass. mpc_jarvis.pine reworked its anchor on 2026-07-31; this engine still matches sos_fade_strategy.pine, which is the file the bot actually replays (Aaron's call). Porting the rework would MANUFACTURE drift in the bot rather than remove it. Nothing trades on it either way - sos_fade computes the macro zone and reports it, execution never reads it. The indicator's own toggle is labelled OFF while being refined and ticking it does nothing. A gate that can NEVER pass is worse than no gate, because people learn to scroll past it - so the macro half is excluded and the other three fibs are gated for real. Revisit ONLY when the rework reaches the strategy file, at which point the 1-minute source becomes an architectural decision, not a port.
